title: Chapter 10 — AI Quiz: Ethics & Ownership
instructions: Original AI-authored practice, not an official Cambridge or teacher paper. Answer all questions; written responses are self-marked using the guidance after submission. You can retake the quiz.
description: Original chapter practice: multiple-choice and written questions with self-marking guidance.

questions.text: Which action is an example of software piracy?

options.text: Copying proprietary software without a licence
Using an open-source licence as permitted

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Copying proprietary software without a licence.

options.text: All facts in a database regardless of law

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Original expression of a work.

questions.text: Describe one privacy risk from collecting personal data.

answer.text: Personal information could be disclosed, misused or accessed without consent.

questions.text: State one difference between open-source and proprietary software.

answer.text: Open-source licences make source code available with specified rights to use, modify and redistribute; proprietary licences generally restrict those rights.

questions.text: Explain one environmental impact of computing and one mitigation.

answer.text: Manufacturing and disposal create electronic waste or emissions.
Extend device lifetimes, reuse or recycle responsibly, or reduce energy use.

questions.text: Explain one ethical concern about automated decisions.

answer.text: Biased data or design can produce unfair outcomes.
Decisions should be assessed, explained and subject to suitable human review.
